t: A whitepaper guide for teaching secondary robotics with a Spot robot.
steps: Find the Spot Robot Curriculum whitepaper on the Boston Dynamics site.
Check whether a form is needed to download it.
Read the sections on use cases and funding.
Read the safety protocol before the robot arrives.
Ask IT to review network and software needs.
Plan a clear space for the robot to move.
Start with the operating lessons before programming.
